graphs.title: The net uptake rises with light, then levels off.
graphs.label: Net uptake

experiment.aim: To find the light intensity at which a leaf takes in no net carbon dioxide
experiment.hypothesis: Net uptake is negative in the dark and rises with light intensity

steps: Set the light to 0 klux and press Record.
Raise the light a little at a time and press Record each time.
Find the light intensity where the net uptake is zero.
title: Light intensity and photosynthesis in a leaf
goal: Find the light intensity at which a leaf's photosynthesis balances its respiration.
note: A leaf photosynthesises and respires at the same time. At the compensation point the net exchange of carbon dioxide is zero. This is a teaching curve, not measured data.
